name: sc-1.5
title: SC 1.5 — Supply Chain Due Diligence
description: State-complete Vue 3 design spec for Diginex SC 1.5 — supply chain due diligence platform with Party/Facility/PartyRole model, risk assessment, CAPs, and audit trails. Diginex Library v4.0.0 tokens (lilac-3 primary, orange-3 secondary, Nuxt UI v4 on Tailwind v4 slate neutrals).

query.en: Build a detailed design spec for SC 1.5 — {{screens}} with every state covered (loading, empty, error, success per screen). Uses Diginex Library v4.0.0 design system. Designer will translate this into Figma.

inputs.name: screens
inputs.label: Which screens to spec?
inputs.placeholder: e.g. supplier profile, risk dashboard, audit list, CAP detail

inputs.name: constraints
inputs.label: Constraints (optional)
inputs.placeholder: Specific interactions, edge cases, designer preferences
